html:
G'oya

COALESCE argumentlarini chapdan o'ngga ko'rib chiqadi va birinchi NULL bo'lmaganini qaytaradi. Bizga aynan shu kerak: avval telefon, keyin email, oxirida yo'q.

Yechim

SELECT id, name, COALESCE(phone, email, 'yo''q') AS contact
FROM customers

Bu CASE WHEN phone IS NOT NULL THEN phone WHEN email IS NOT NULL THEN email ELSE 'yo''q' END ning qisqa yozuvi, natija bir xil.

Tuzoqlar

Argumentlar tartibi ustuvorlikni belgilaydi. Email birinchi tursa, ikkalasi ham bor mijozda (namunada Aziz) telefon o'rniga email chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, name, COALESCE(email, phone, 'yo''q') AS contact
FROM customers

Oxirgi 'yo''q' ni unutsangiz, Jasur kabi telefoni ham, emaili ham yo'q mijozda contact NULL bo'lib qoladi.
